source.label: Target adapters, artifact audits, release receipts and provider portal checks
filters: Every canonical release target is listed, including research-only, blocked and account-gated targets.
Status is reported only when supported by repository code, release evidence, official provider documentation or an authenticated provider portal.

metricDefinitions.label: Integration status
metricDefinitions.definition: Implemented means the target owns a provider-specific adapter and its isolated local build and audit pass. It does not imply provider approval or production promotion.

metricDefinitions.label: Release status
metricDefinitions.definition: The latest verified provider-side state, kept separate from local build readiness.

source.label: Deployment monitoring coverage and imported provider measurements
filters: No engagement or performance measurements have been imported. Release readiness is not runtime performance.
One row per target, deployment, environment and UTC day. Missing values are null, never zero. Provider definitions must match the import contract.
YouTube, Netflix and Yahoo candidates use provider-side reports only; no analytics SDK is added to game artifacts.

metricDefinitions.label: Active players
metricDefinitions.definition: Distinct players with a gameplay action during the UTC day in this deployment. Never summed across days or deployments.

metricDefinitions.label: Sessions and engagement
metricDefinitions.definition: Provider-counted sessions, games started and completed; completion rate = gamesCompleted / gamesStarted. Average engaged seconds = engagedSeconds / sessions. Missing or zero denominators yield unavailable.

metricDefinitions.label: Performance
metricDefinitions.definition: Load p95 is the provider-computed 95th percentile of milliseconds from launch to playable, with loadSamples as its denominator. Error-session rate = errorSessions / observedSessions; observedSessions is the error-monitored population. Percentiles and rates are never averaged across rows.

metricDefinitions.label: Freshness
metricDefinitions.definition: Missing means no metrics; partial means some metrics are missing; stale means the UTC reporting day ended over 48 hours ago. Collection time is shown separately.

rows.subject: Riddle Quest — a multilingual browser word game built for quick daily play
rows.body:
Hi [Name],

I’m Craig from Roobs World Limited, an independent UK game studio. I’d like to introduce Riddle Quest, a free HTML5 word game that combines written riddles with colour clues, daily challenges, streaks and competitive Race to 10 play.

It is designed for quick sessions on desktop and mobile, includes 17 languages, and uses a distinctive solar-system presentation with original music.

Play it here: https://yahoo.roobsworld.com
Game and studio information: https://www.roobsworld.com/riddle-quest

I think it could suit [Website] because [one specific reason based on their audience or recent coverage]. Would you be interested in covering, reviewing or featuring it? I can provide screenshots, logos, gameplay video, an interview, or any additional build information you need.

Best,
Craig Beswetherick
Roobs World Limited
https://www.roobsworld.com

source.label: Google Cloud Logging request logs and Cloud Run deployment inventory
filters: Rolling 24-hour window. All pages read before publication; failed or truncated reads retain the last successful snapshot.
Includes development probes, rejected requests and OPTIONS traffic. Request counts are not players, sessions or completed games.
Each current ready backend revision is represented even when no request logs were observed. Older revisions with traffic remain visible.
Retired revisions retain their last observed reporting window and are labelled Historical. Their values are not current-window traffic.
Latency is server request latency, not game launch-to-playable. Shared endpoints are not attributed to a client target.

metricDefinitions.label: Backend traffic and performance
metricDefinitions.definition: Requests count observed HTTP request logs per service/revision. Successful requests are HTTP 2xx; client errors 4xx; server errors 5xx. p95 is nearest-rank over latency samples from this same group. No samples means unavailable.

metricDefinitions.label: Refresh status
metricDefinitions.definition: Only updated after complete provider retrieval and durable snapshot publication. The browser checks for updated snapshots every minute.
